content.comment_body: Hello, I'm working with a [article_no] [product_name] module (features: 8 digital inputs, 4 analog inputs 0...10V range). When I connect this [product_name] module to my laptop running [product_name] [version_no], I can successfully test the network connection. However, when creating a logic diagram, I need to select the correct hardware type to access appropriate function blocks. When I choose the hardware type ([article_no].[version_no] Standard), it shows only 6 digital inputs, but my module actually has 8. Does anyone know why this is happening?

[company_name] has updated their article numbers. Your [product_name] with the article number [article_no] does not match [version_no] in device selection; it corresponds to [product_name] [version_no] instead.
Thank you, I didn't realize that. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants encounter confusion when trying to match [company_name] product article numbers to hardware selection options in the [product_name] configuration software. The numbering does not correspond directly, leading to incorrect module configurations and difficulty accessing correct hardware features within the software.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want a straightforward mapping between the article number found on physical modules and the hardware configuration options within the [product_name] software, enabling proper setup of digital and analog inputs without ambiguity.
